# Supadata: Web & video to text API for makers

Supadata is a comprehensive API for extracting transcripts, metadata, and structured content from videos and the web. It is designed for makers, indie hackers, and engineering teams who need reliable access to public web content for AI training, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), data analysis, and content workflows.

Website: https://supadata.ai
Documentation: https://docs.supadata.ai
Dashboard: https://dash.supadata.ai
Status: https://status.supadata.ai
Feedback / Changelog: https://feedback.supadata.ai

## What Supadata does

Supadata exposes a single, consistent REST API surface that lets you:

- Get transcripts (captions / subtitles) from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), Facebook, and arbitrary video file URLs.
- Get metadata (title, description, author, statistics, thumbnails) from videos and channels on the same platforms.
- Scrape any public web page into clean Markdown ready for LLM consumption.
- Crawl entire websites — Supadata follows internal links and returns clean Markdown for every page.
- Map a site's URL structure without downloading every page.
- Use AI to extract structured JSON data from videos by describing the schema you want.
- Browse YouTube channels and playlists, including paginated video lists and batch transcript jobs.

You do not need to run browsers, manage proxies, or maintain platform-specific scrapers. Supadata abstracts all of that behind one API key.

## Authentication

All requests authenticate with a single header:

```
x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
```

Sign up at https://dash.supadata.ai to get a key. The free Basic tier includes 100 credits per month with no credit card required.

Base URL: `https://api.supadata.ai/v1`

## Endpoint summary

The endpoints below all sit under `https://api.supadata.ai/v1` and use `x-api-key` for authentication.

### Universal video endpoints

- `GET /transcript?url=...&lang=en&text=true` — Returns a transcript for a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), Facebook, or generic video file URL. Supports 100+ languages, automatic detection, and either raw segments or plain text.
- `GET /transcript/{jobId}` — Poll the status/result of an async transcript job (used for long videos or batch jobs).
- `GET /metadata?url=...` — Returns metadata (title, description, channel/author, statistics, thumbnails, duration) for media on the supported platforms.

### YouTube-specific endpoints

- `GET /youtube/video?id=...` — Detailed metadata for a single YouTube video.
- `GET /youtube/channel?id=...` — Channel information (name, subscribers, video count, banner, etc.).
- `GET /youtube/channel/videos?id=...&limit=...` — Paginated list of videos for a channel.
- `GET /youtube/playlist?id=...` — Playlist metadata (title, video count, channel).
- `GET /youtube/playlist/videos?id=...&limit=...` — Paginated list of videos in a playlist.
- `POST /youtube/transcript/batch` — Submit many YouTube videos for batched transcript extraction. Returns a job ID that can be polled.
- `GET /youtube/transcript/batch/{jobId}` — Retrieve batch transcript results.

### Web endpoints

- `GET /web/scrape?url=...` — Scrape a single page and return clean Markdown plus extracted metadata.
- `POST /web/crawl` — Start a crawl that follows internal links from a seed URL and returns Markdown for every page (subject to scope / depth limits).
- `GET /web/crawl/{jobId}` — Retrieve crawl results.
- `GET /web/map?url=...` — Return a list of URLs discovered on a site without downloading each page.

### AI extraction

- `POST /ai/extract` — Given a video URL plus a JSON schema (or natural-language description), return structured JSON extracted from the video using an LLM. Useful for turning unstructured videos into application-ready data.

Full request/response examples live at https://docs.supadata.ai.

## Supported platforms

Transcript and metadata endpoints accept URLs from:

- YouTube (videos, shorts, livestreams once ended)
- TikTok (videos, including auto-captions)
- Instagram (Reels, IGTV, posts with video)
- X / Twitter (videos in posts)
- Facebook (public videos)
- Generic video file URLs (MP4, MOV, WebM, MP3, etc.) — Supadata transcribes them with its Whisper V3 Turbo pipeline.

Languages: 100+ supported transcript languages with automatic detection.

## Pricing and rate limits

All plans share the same endpoints; only credits per month and rate limits differ. Credits are consumed per call (most calls = 1 credit; some web/AI calls = more).

| Plan | Price (USD / month) | Credits / month | Rate limit |
|------|--------------------|-----------------|------------|
| Basic | Free | 100 | 1 request / second |
| Pro | $9 | 1,000 | 50 requests / second |
| Ultra | $29 | 10,000 | 50 requests / second |
| Mega | $59 | 50,000 | 200 requests / second |
| Giga | $99 | 100,000 | 500 requests / second |
| Supa | $897 | 1,000,000 | 100 requests / second (custom SLA) |

Full pricing: https://supadata.ai/pricing

## SDKs

Official SDKs maintained by the Supadata team:

- JavaScript / TypeScript: `@supadata/js` — works in Node.js, Deno, Bun, and the browser. https://github.com/supadata-ai/js — https://www.npmjs.com/package/@supadata/js
- Python: `supadata` — works in Python 3.9+. https://github.com/supadata-ai/py — https://pypi.org/project/supadata/

Both SDKs cover every endpoint, handle retries, and ship with typed responses.

## No-code integrations

Supadata is available as a first-party app on the major automation platforms:

- Zapier: https://zapier.com/apps/supadata/integrations
- Make: https://www.make.com/en/integrations/supadata
- n8n: https://n8n.io/integrations/supadata/
- Active Pieces: https://www.activepieces.com/pieces/supadata

Typical workflows: monitor a YouTube channel → transcribe new uploads → summarize with GPT → post to Notion / Slack / Airtable.

## MCP server (for AI assistants & IDEs)

Supadata ships an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that exposes its tools to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible clients.

Repository: https://github.com/supadata-ai/mcp

Once installed, the assistant can fetch transcripts, scrape pages, and extract structured data from videos directly inside the editor.

## Error reference

Errors return JSON with an `error` and `message` field. Common codes:

- `invalid-request` (HTTP 400) — Malformed request, missing parameters, or invalid URL. See https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/invalid-request.
- `unauthorized` (HTTP 401) — Missing or invalid `x-api-key`. See https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/unauthorized.
- `not-found` (HTTP 404) — The requested video, channel, playlist, or page does not exist or is private. See https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/not-found.
- `limit-exceeded` (HTTP 429) — You hit your plan's rate limit. Slow down or upgrade. See https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/limit-exceeded.
- `upgrade-required` (HTTP 402) — Feature requires a higher plan. See https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/upgrade-required.
- `transcript-unavailable` (HTTP 404 / 422) — Source has no transcript and cannot be auto-generated (e.g. video has no audio, is age-restricted, or is region-blocked). See https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/transcript-unavailable.
- `internal-error` (HTTP 500) — Unexpected server error. Retry with exponential backoff; if it persists, report at https://feedback.supadata.ai. See https://docs.supadata.ai/errors/internal-error.
